title: X Ads Conversion API: POST https://ads-api.x.com/12/measurement/conversions/{pixel_id}
description: Transcribed from https://docs.x.com/x-ads-api/measurement/web-conversions and gtm-server-side (fetched 2026-09-29) and the archived API reference (web.archive.org capture 2025-11-18 of developer.x.com/.../api-reference/conversions; docs.x.com has no live reference page). Auth: OAuth 1.0a user context (HMAC-SHA1), added by the live transport. 'Up to 500 conversion events may be provided' comes from the archived reference only.

event_id.description: The Events Manager event id (the conversion type, e.g. tw-o5h34-o9p5x), not the dedup key.

identifiers.description: 'At least one of the identifier objects (twclid or email) is required'; IP/UA only 'alongside a second identifier'.

conversion_id.description: 'For deduplication between pixel and conversion API conversions.'
